annotations.title: VPS price index by country and RAM

description: Use for «how much does a VPS cost in Germany», «average VPS price for 4 GB», «which country has cheaper VPS». The accsly.io VPS price index: median monthly price of a plan and of 1 GB of RAM overall, by RAM size (1-32 GB, NVMe and SSD medians), and by server country (plans, hosts, median, per GB of RAM, cheapest plan with 2 GB+). Pass country to get only those countries. Same figures as the page /vps/prices, recomputed hourly from the catalog.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes; empty = every country of the index.

locale.description: Language of names and page links; also the price currency: ru = RUB, en = USD, de/es/pt = EUR, tr = TRY.
